base_rates.summary: Comparing an IPO's price with listed peers describes it consistently, but on 2018-2026 history it did not predict returns after listing: IPOs priced cheaply against peers did not beat dearly priced ones over 6 or 12 months. Heavy QIB subscription strongly predicted a bigger listing-day gain, but not returns after that. The median IPO trailed the Smallcap 250 by about 16% over its first year.
